title.zh: 杠杆与滑轮 · 支点挪一挪，省力见分晓
title.en: Levers & Pulleys · Move the Fulcrum, Feel the Trade

desc.zh: 小力凭什么撬动大物？这一页算两本账。转动的账看力矩：力 × 力臂，两边相等就平衡——支点挪一挪，同样的重物要用的力立刻变。可省力从不是白省：功的账本两边永远相等，省几倍力就费几倍距离。到了滑轮组更干脆，不用算，数一数吊着重物的绳子段数，就知道省几倍力。全页 g 取 10 N/kg，力一律用牛顿（N）。
desc.en: How can a small force lift a huge weight? This page keeps two ledgers. The turning ledger is torque: force × lever arm — when both sides match, the lever balances, and sliding the fulcrum changes the force you need at once. But saved force is never free: the work ledger always balances, so every multiple of force saved costs the same multiple of distance. For pulley systems it is even simpler — do not compute, just count the rope segments holding the load. Throughout, g = 10 N/kg and forces are in newtons (N).
